title: Which Is More Likely?
summary: List every outcome and count the ones you want.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: You toss a fair coin 3 times.
Is getting 3 heads in a row less likely than getting exactly 1 head in 3 tosses?
points: You toss a fair coin 3 times.

steps.title: The method: List all outcomes
sentences: There are 8 outcomes: HHH, HHT, HTH, HTT, THH, THT, TTH, TTT.
HHH happens in only 1 of them.
Exactly 1 head happens in HTT, THT and TTH, which is 3 of them.
points: There are 8 outcomes: HHH, HHT, HTH, HTT, THH, THT, TTH, TTT.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: Three heads has a chance of 1 in 8.
Exactly one head has a chance of 3 in 8.
So exactly one head is three times as likely.
points: Three heads has a chance of 1 in 8.

quiz.q: A fair coin lands heads 4 times. What is the chance the next toss is heads?
